title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 2, QA) - Quant - Geometry
subject: Quant

questions.q: $ABCD$ is a trapezium in which $AB$ is parallel to $CD$. The sides $AD$ and $BC$ when extended, intersect at point ${E}$. If $AB = 2 \text{ cm}, CD = 1 \text{ cm}$, and perimeter of $ABCD$ is 6 cm, then the perimeter, in cm, of $\triangle AEB$ is
questions.explain: Since $AB || CD$, $\triangle EDC \sim \triangle EAB$. The ratio of corresponding sides is $CD/AB = 1/2$. Let $ED=x, EC=y$. Then $EA=2x, EB=2y$. So $AD=x, BC=y$. Perimeter of $ABCD = AB+BC+CD+DA = 2+y+1+x=6$, so $x+y=3$. The perimeter of $\triangle AEB = EA+EB+AB = 2x+2y+2 = 2(x+y)+2 = 2(3)+2 = 8$.

questions.q: Three circles of equal radii touch each other externally. Two other circles, ${x}$ and ${y}$, are drawn such that both touch each of the three previous circles. If the radius of ${x}$ is more than that of ${y}$, the ratio of the radii of ${x}$ and ${y}$ is
questions.explain: Let the radius of the three equal circles be ${r}$. Their centers form an equilateral triangle of side $2r$. The centroid of this triangle is the center of circles X and Y. The distance from a vertex to the centroid is $(2r/\sqrt{3})$. Let the radii of X and Y be $R_X$ and $R_Y$. Circle X is the circumcircle of the gap, so its radius is $R_X = 2r/\sqrt{3} + r$. Circle Y is in the central gap, so its radius is $R_Y = 2r/\sqrt{3} - r$. The ratio is $\frac{R_X}{R_Y} = \frac{2/\sqrt{3}+1}{2/\sqrt{3}-1} = \frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{2-\sqrt{3}} = (2+\sqrt{3})^2 = 4+3+4\sqrt{3} = 7+4\sqrt{3}$. The ratio is $7+4\sqrt{3}:1$.
